title: Siting rules relaxed —
the noise limit decides the job
sub: Permitted development finally allows the unit where it belongs. From 28 May 2026 the calculation that gets it approved is MCS 020(a).

caption: at 1 m from the neighbour's nearest
habitable-room window — tightened from 42 dB(A)

rows.label: Sound POWER level of the unit — not sound pressure
Reflective surfaces and siting are accounted for
Six-year workmanship warranty under the new MCS scheme
Above 37 dB(A): a full planning application is needed

sections.title: In short
lines: Where the unit may go is now a question of acoustics, not tape measures.
Sound power on the data sheet decides whether a job stays permitted
development — which makes it a specification decision, not a site one.
